_comment: Bounded candidate acceptance from final local evidence; not publication, macOS certification, account sync or legal clearance.
completion_scope: Final package-byte audits, declared native attachment/line-quad/lifecycle checks, both full offline logs and post-cleanup stopped-state audits pass. This completes the requested bounded 0.3.6 implementation/acceptance, not the explicitly excluded product, legal or release scopes.

reportcheck_counting.definition: Counts are final report.checks assertions, not unique features, documents or semantic quality scores. Disjoint attachment_identity_reader, line_quads and lifecycle counts sum to total.
reportcheck_counting.line_quads_definition: Inclusive range from 'Native reader loads production schema-two line geometry' through 'Native CSS highlights paint text without paragraph whitespace': 17 assertions per report.
reportcheck_counting.lifecycle_definition: Assertions from the first '[native prerequisite]' onward; mixed native Zotero, frontend, filesystem and actual backend checks, not all native-only.
reportcheck_counting.attachment_identity_reader_definition: Remaining installation/identity, attachment publication/download, reader, degradation and zero-request assertions; includes the Linux bundled ZIP-export assertion.

reading_and_lifecycle_limits.trusted_asset: Versioned native imported JSON attachment; exact attachment keys/owner/PDF bytes and schema-two geometry checked before precise reading, without local translation jobs.
reading_and_lifecycle_limits.line_geometry: Trusted native pointer events, one polygon per verified line, CSS text highlights and no precise hit on interline or short-line trailing whitespace, on both PDFs.
reading_and_lifecycle_limits.lifecycle: Native trash/restore/permanent erasure, translated PDF/note/annotation/map retention, independent shared owners, actual backend pruning of proven disposable cache and true-process cold reopen.
reading_and_lifecycle_limits.fixtures: Lifecycle cache PDFs and sidecars are supplied fixtures; immutable identities and shared jobs are synthetic. lifecycle.engineOutcomes is 'not run', not a model-task acceptance.
reading_and_lifecycle_limits.stub_only: Incomplete-index and active/unknown/job-reference safeguards are two frontend stub-only assertions per create report. Native publisher and actual backend prune checks are separately identified in the reports.
reading_and_lifecycle_limits.zero_request_counter_scope: Every final reading report has engineStarts=0 and backendRequests=0 for reading/hash/navigation/hover. Lifecycle has its own actual backend PID/prune operations and providerCalls=0; these counters do not imply no backend ever started.

webdav_a_to_b.metadata_transport: Stopped-database seed preserving exact keys, not account cloud metadata sync.
webdav_a_to_b.file_transport: Actual native WebDAV.downloadFile via Storage.Request.start; receiver starts with empty storage, no copied PDFs/JSON, no translation journal/sidecar/extracted Python engine.
webdav_a_to_b.receipt_checks: Missing at Request.start, actual localChanges, exact native key/filename/path, producer MD5/size, in_sync and source/translated/mapping byte identity all pass.
webdav_a_to_b.manifest_status: No separate manifest file exists in the allowed ledger directory; attachment inventory is taken only from the final producer export and receiver reports.
webdav_a_to_b.request_status_limit: The ledger retains four 401 and two 404 responses; all six ZIP GETs completed with 200. Non-200 responses are not erased or counted as failed ZIP downloads; their cause is not inferred here.
webdav_a_to_b.degradation: Corrupt/undownloaded map, replaced PDF bytes, wrong source/owner/schema and deleted original disable precise controls only; ordinary reading/page sync and restored exact-pair reading remain available without retranslating.

windows.encoding: UTF-8 normalized from the retained original UTF-16 PowerShell log; no result content changed.

offline.skip_reason: tests/test_references.py skips its optional scientific reference PDF when that local fixture is absent; final logs have one skip.
offline.scope_limit: Offline source contracts do not replace exact-XPI native acceptance, cloud sync, public update delivery or human translation review.

shared_lightweight_ci.scope: Shared-source portability contracts only; not native macOS, runtime building or whole-paper quality acceptance.

earlier_failure.cause: The fixture read a lazy interpreter sysconfig ABI after simulating sys.platform, requesting nonexistent _sysconfigdata__linux_darwin.
earlier_failure.resolution: Capture the actual interpreter ABI before simulating another host; fix the existing test without skipping or weakening provenance checks.

linux_package_size.scope: OpenCV 4.12.0 core/imgproc/imgcodecs/python3 only, matching the existing macOS module scope without testing or changing macOS; Windows retains its official wheel.
linux_package_size.limits: Same-source before/after measurement archives are historical, pre-final NOTICE integration and not the accepted final XPIs. Native probe results and compiler-symbol checks do not certify native execution on every older distro.

failure_history.current_round_early_failed_report_audit: Earlier failures remain retained and are not counted as passes. Reader Xray page access, reopened reader reuse and native viewport/trash-restoration helper failures were fixed directly before distinct final reports; no original report was rewritten.

rejected_linux_toolchain_trial.result: Ubuntu 24.04 GCC 13 output required glibc 2.38; rejected, not staged or shipped.

historical_stable_delivery.version_contract_failure: Published 0.3.3 target health stayed 0.3.2; a distinct 0.3.4 fixed it, without replacing 0.3.3 assets.
historical_stable_delivery.windows_daily_credential_failure: Original acceptance accidentally saved settings and changed PaperBridge's stored key. Authorized repair had a bounded logical-key pass, but original failure and strict stored-record false flags remain; not a 0.3.6 daily-upgrade pass.

stopped_state_and_integrity.integrity_check: all ok before and after cleanup

cleanup.daily_environment_noninterference: Daily Linux Zotero and its engine remain running; no daily profiles/NSS/databases, Windows original checkout or global settings changed.
cleanup.note: Only explicit disposable builds or stopped installed-marker engine roots were removed; unknown ownership and native storage/cache/task results were retained. Removed engine source/marker identities and small build evidence were archived first.

evidence_integrity.evidence_labels: Repository-relative labels are local, non-public evidence, not web links. Ignored .runtime/ and agent/codex/ materials are not claimed to be published or clickable online.
evidence_integrity.source_relationship: The supplied baseline head is a reference, not a claim that it contains every final candidate edit. Each final audit records exact XPI SHA/CRC, matching bytes for 70 shipped source/material entries and model/tokenizer SHA. All four normalized source/material hash maps agree. Final native reports and lifecycle markers bind to those exact package SHA/build IDs, not to same-name older packages. No source commit is generated for this JSON.
evidence_integrity.build_id_limit: Payload/backend build IDs alone do not prove addon bytes; final shipping-byte audits and installed-XPI SHA checks are both required and used.

delivery_confirmation.evidence: User-provided main-agent update in this chat
delivery_confirmation.four_dist_sha256sum_results: all OK, executed from dist with each package's checksum file
delivery_confirmation.windows_final_screenshot_visual_review: Three final screenshots reviewed; both representative paragraphs have per-line quads excluding interline and short-final-line whitespace.

evidence_differences: Historical size-analysis measurement after archives differ from final accepted Linux XPIs: final bundled and local archives are each 72205 bytes larger and have different SHA values. Do not substitute measurement hashes or treat their historical stage-unchanged fields as current promotion state.
Linux bundled create has 90 checks, versus 89 for the other create reports, because it also exports three native attachment ZIPs; this is not an extra geometry or lifecycle pass.
Windows local final audit has zero inventory warnings but still reports licenseCompliance=unknown; absence of warnings is not legal clearance.
The allowed WebDAV directory has counts/download/request ledgers but no separate manifest. Receipts and producer export inventory agree; no unseen manifest is claimed.
